book_title: World War II London Blitz Diary, Volume 1
author: Ruby Side Thompson
book_description: While hundreds of Messerschmitt war planes fly overhead and the sound of hundreds of bombs exploding, Ruby Side Thompson's writes her personal during the terrifying World War Two London Blitz. Her diary is a true and detailed account of what she experienced during that horrific time. The diary chronicles Ruby's struggle to survive in the midst of a horrendous war, where London is bombed nightly. In this true account Ruby speaks frankly and honestly.Show more
